exposure: Reason for Cesarean (nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracing, maternal complications)
Implementation of a structured response team (Code OBERT) for unscheduled emergency cesareans
outcome: Decision to incision time for unscheduled emergency cesareans
cohort: Mothers undergoing unscheduled emergency cesareans at a community hospital.
finding: Implementation of a structured response team (Code OBERT) for unscheduled emergency cesareans reduced the mean decision to incision time from 80.8 minutes to 40.4 minutes.
